root_cause: The refactor that introduced texdsp_ctx-based slice_count computation (replacing the previous FFMAX(ctx->texture_block_h, ctx->ctexture_block_h) based divisor) did not add a guard ensuring the coded_height-derived divisor used in av_clip()'s max argument is >= 1 before calling av_clip(), allowing pathological small coded_height values from attacker-controlled input to violate av_clip()'s min<=max invariant.
findings: In dxv_decode(), the slice_count values for the texdsp and chroma-texdsp decompression contexts are computed with av_clip(avctx->thread_count, 1, avctx->coded_height / TEXTURE_BLOCK_H) and av_clip(avctx->thread_count, 1, cavctx.coded_height / TEXTURE_BLOCK_H).
